reason: ₹1,999 every month is a big piece of what we earn, and with almost no grid here I would also need the ₹6,500 solar kit just to charge it. And when there is no power the borewell pump does not run either, so there is no water for the machine anyway.
objection: I am not sure a cold wash will get the mud out of farm clothes. If I still have to scrub them by hand first, I am paying a monthly instalment for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: An EMI under ₹1,000 a month with the solar panel included, and seeing it clean a neighbour's muddy work clothes in front of me.
